title: fix(runtime): GET /i18n/translations/:locale carries an ETag and Cache-Control: private, no-cache, and a matching If-None-Match is answered 304 (#25785)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DEVkZEEx5UmhSJgP3kcEfLX)_

Part of #25785 (the first step the triage comment 6397341079 names: the validator and cache directive on the bundle). #25785 remains open for its second half, keeping `metadataForms` out of the boot bundle, which is a wire-shape change for `domain:spec`.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The claim is 6407675488 (seat `domain:server#2`, card thread `session_01HFAuCZPty5SsvseoPRgukQ`). Declared surface addition: amendment 6408228005 (one `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` row, below).

## What changes

`GET /i18n/translations/:locale` (and its `?locale=` spelling) answered every console open with the whole locale bundle and no `ETag` or `Cache-Control`, so the browser could not revalidate what it already held. On a hosted tenant that is 80–88 KB compressed per open (the card's cloud#2914 reading).

1. **`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`**, the one handler body every transport converges on. A new `translationsAnswer` builds the translations answer on both of the route's success exits (the direct read and the `zh` → `zh-CN` fallback):
   - the `200` is `deps.success`'s envelope, unchanged, plus `ETag` and `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`;
   - the `ETag` is weak, `W/"BASE64URL-SHA256"` over `JSON.stringify` of the exact envelope served (`locale`, `requestedLocale` and `translations`), **computed on every read**. Nothing cheaper (a counter, the bundle object's identity) stands in for the bytes, so a `304` can only ever pin a caller to the bundle it really holds. It is weak because it vouches for the JSON, not for the encoding a compressing layer puts on the wire. This is the invariant `getMetaItemCached` states for `/meta` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`), with SHA-256 in place of its 32-bit hash;
   - a request whose `If-None-Match` names that representation (RFC 9110 §13.1.2: a comma list, weak comparison, or `*`) is answered `{ status: 304, headers }` with no `body`. The `304` carries the same two headers (§15.4.5). A malformed or stale tag is served the full bundle, the safe direction;
   - `private` because the bundle is served only to a signed-in caller and names the application's own objects; `no-cache` because the bundle changes without notice (an authored translation, a package install), so freshness is the validator's job and never a TTL.
   - The anonymous floor (ADR-0056 D2) is still the handler's first statement: an anonymous caller holding the current validator is refused `401`, and no refusal carries either header.
2. **No transport change.** `dispatcher-plugin.ts`'s `sendResultBase` and `@objectstack/hono`'s `toResponse` already write `body: undefined` as a body-less response (`JSON.stringify(undefined)` is `undefined`, so Hono builds `Response(undefined, { status: 304 })`). Both are now pinned on that.
3. **Declared surface addition (amendment 6408228005).** `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` `DISPATCHER_DOMAINS['i18n.ts']` goes 0 → 2 with a note: the two answers are kind 1, the same classification `meta.ts` took for `Vary: Accept-Language` (`deps.success` takes no headers, and a `304` has no envelope a helper could build). No other row and no gate logic moves, and `DomainHandlerDeps` gains no member.
4. **Changeset**: `@objectstack/runtime` patch.

Not touched: `packages/spec`, every published response schema (the `200` body is byte-identical and `GetTranslationsResponseSchema` is unchanged), `/i18n/locales`, `/i18n/labels/*`.

The console needs no change: `ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts` reads the bundle through `createAuthenticatedFetch`, a plain `fetch(input, { ...init, headers })` with the default cache mode, so the browser sends `If-None-Match` itself and hands the console the cached body on a `304`.

## Measured on a real composition

`examples/app-crm` booted with `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh` from this branch (full `pnpm build`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`), signed in as the seeded admin, read over loopback with `curl`:

| locale | cold read | read again with the issued `ETag` in `If-None-Match` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `zh-CN` | `200`, 220,391 B raw (67,303 B at `gzip -9`; the dev server does not compress) | `304`, 0 B |
| `en` | `200`, 213,264 B raw (58,351 B at `gzip -9`) | `304`, 0 B |

- Both answers carry `Cache-Control: private, no-cache` and the same `ETag`; the `200` keeps `Vary: Origin` from the CORS layer.
- 25 cold reads of `zh-CN` answered one `ETag`, and 25 conditional reads all answered `304`.
- The `ETag` recomputed offline from the served `zh-CN` body equals the header byte for byte (`W/"cOAyyUQ7yb5bulH5g7ybiAf8sbJebhwAZur_peIct_E"`): the invariant, read on the real bundle.
- **Cost.** The extra `JSON.stringify` plus SHA-256 of the 220 KB envelope is 1.8 ms per read on this 4-core shared box (stringify alone 0.9 ms; mean of 50 after a warm-up). Loopback wall time: `200` median 16.1 ms, `304` median 11.6 ms over 25 reads each. The saving the card targets is the bytes: on the ops seat's measured link (326–464 KB/s) the 80–88 KB compressed hosted bundle is about 0.2–0.27 s per warm open.
- **Before.** `origin/main` `cb0a2fcf`'s handler sets no header on this route (the card's measurement on pin `888d6865` shows none, and the ablation below reds every header assertion on that blob).

## Verification

Commits: `a373155e` (the fix), `e8c4b7a7` (runtime tests), `0b2e6592` (adapter test, changeset), `7b2a1a2b` (test typing), `773c3f3b` (the gate row). Each reading names its head.

- **New tests.**
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n-translations-etag.test.ts`, 21 tests on the handler body: the `200` headers on both spellings and the fallback arm; the validator recomputed from the served body; stable while unchanged; moves on a one-string change and on an in-place mutation of the same bundle object; `304` for the weak tag, its strong spelling, a list with and without spaces, `*`, a Fetch `Headers` object and a repeated header in the record shape, on both spellings; full bundle for a stale, unquoted or empty tag; a validator issued before a change gets the new bundle; one locale's validator does not answer another locale; the anonymous floor answers `401` with no headers and the provider unread.
  - `packages/runtime/src/i18n-translations-etag.hono.integration.test.ts`, 4 tests over a real socket (`LiteKernel` + `HonoServerPlugin` + `createDispatcherPlugin`): `200` with both headers and the same envelope; `304` with a 0-byte body and both headers; a validator from before a bundle change is served the new bundle; anonymous with the validator is `401`, no `ETag`.
  - `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono-not-modified-response.test.ts`, 3 tests: a dispatcher `{ status: 304, headers }` leaves `toResponse` as a 0-byte `304` with both headers; the domain is handed the raw `Request` whose `if-none-match` it reads; the `200` control keeps its JSON body. Characterization pins: `toResponse` is unchanged, and they were green before the domain change.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first, `i18n.ts` replaced on disk by its `origin/main` `cb0a2fcf` blob under a trap, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`): the two runtime files went 23 failed of 25. The 2 that stay green are controls that hold either way (the missing-locale `400` carries no headers; anonymous gets `401`). Restored blob `bb41d094` equals `HEAD`'s, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean.
- **Package suites.** At `0b2e6592` (the later commits touch only the integration test's typing, re-run green at `7b2a1a2b`, and the gate row): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (vitest `local` project, under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`): 446 files, 7,125 passed, 19 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono test`: 13 files, 228 passed. `typecheck` for both packages exits 0 (runtime's includes `check:test-typecheck`, which first caught two untyped `res.json()` reads in the integration test, fixed in 7b2a1a2b).
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at head `773c3f3b` derives 87 families on the 6 changed paths, and all 87 exit 0 (each exit code captured before any pipe). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. The first run, at `7b2a1a2b` (67 families), had three that were not green: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3: the shallow clone lacked the fixture commit `621a4876`, and `dist/` was unbuilt), and both exit 0 after fetching that commit and a full `pnpm build`; `check:route-envelope` was red on `i18n.ts handBuilt: found 2, declared 0`, which the declared row above classifies. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the five changed code files exits 0. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of 6 paths hit the register, NOT governed, 561 changed lines.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope by the claim, carrier `domain:spec`:** the card's second half, keeping `metadataForms` (46.8 KB raw on the measured tenant) out of the boot bundle and loading it with Studio, plus the optional scoping of `objects` to the current app. Both change what `GET /i18n/translations/:locale` returns, which is a wire-shape change (triage 6397341079). #25785 stays open for it.
- `/i18n/locales` and `/i18n/labels/:object/:locale` still carry no validator. Neither was measured on the open path and the card does not ask for them; noted, not filed.
